title: 幼稚园
description: 适合2-5岁零基础或刚接触英语的孩子，以单词认知、日常短句、情绪启蒙为主
descriptionEn: For children aged 2-5 with zero or minimal English exposure. Focus on word recognition, daily short sentences, and emotional awareness.

items.description: 每集只攻克一个核心单词，真人小朋友+动画混剪反复带读，公认的开口神器。
items.descriptionEn: Each episode focuses on one core word, mixing real kids and animation for repetitive reading. A well-known speaking booster.

items.description: 穿衣、吃饭、刷牙等宝宝日常，语速极慢，固定句式循环，英音启蒙首选。
items.descriptionEn: Daily routines like dressing, eating, and brushing teeth. Extremely slow speech, fixed sentence loops, top choice for British accent.

items.description: 睡前安抚向，节奏缓慢、画面柔和，适合2岁以下宝宝作为第一部英文短片。
items.descriptionEn: Bedtime soothing, slow pace, soft pictures. Suitable as the first English short for babies under 2.
